::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
## CONVERGING authority

These pages describe the current SCNSim V1 candidate. They do not claim Human
acceptance, stabilization, or release. The `1.0.0.dev4` candidate implements
the Lessons 1–8 slice; later slices remain fail-fast until their reviewed
implementations replace the corresponding unavailable paths.
:::

## Public contracts

Read these when deciding what a Notebook user may declare, execute, inspect,
and resolve.

- [Component Authoring Contract](../component-authoring.qmd) defines catalogs,
  components, pins, electric nodes, ground, Ports, parameters, composites, and
  schematic projections.
- [V1 Runtime Contract](../v1-runtime-contract.qmd) defines Runs, Refs, Specs,
  units, reduction, Direct/HB behavior, optimization, Results, attempts,
  receipts, failure, and known limits.

Public contracts own product semantics. An implementation page may explain a
mechanism, dependency, data layout, or delivery slice, but it cannot weaken or
replace a public invariant.

## Implementation Design {#implementation-design}

Read this collection in order before changing the scaffold. Each page answers
one maintainer question. Together they cover all thirteen lessons and every
currently declared public V1 surface; a later runtime slice may remain
fail-fast, but its implementation boundary is no longer left implicit.

5. [How is Julia prepared without manual setup?](../implementation/julia-runtime-preparation.qmd)
6. [What crosses the Python–Julia process boundary?](../implementation/python-julia-protocol.qmd)

10. [How do Q2D matrices become a complete pi ladder?](../implementation/rlgc-q2d-and-pi-expansion.qmd)
11. [How does an ordered Ref lineage become one selected network?](../implementation/view-lineage-and-selected-networks.qmd)
12. [How is one loaded diagonal root solved and certified?](../implementation/diagonal-root-numerical-procedure.qmd)
13. [How are poles, zeros, response elements, couplings, and operators evaluated?](../implementation/direct-poles-zeros-and-operators.qmd)
14. [How are Direct operators and optimization evaluated efficiently?](../implementation/direct-quantities-and-optimization.qmd)
15. [How are full V1 HB normalization and case outcomes realized?](../implementation/hb-realization-and-outcomes.qmd)

17. [How are external inputs, provenance, and the four implementation slices bounded?](../implementation/external-inputs-and-delivery.qmd)

The collection remains the implementation authority whether a slice is
executable or still fail-fast. When a future slice changes one of these
decisions, only the affected page and public contract return for Human review.
